slides.say: Use deferred value lets part of your UI lag behind, showing old content while new content loads.
The input uses query. The results get the deferred query.

slides.text: 1) Render with new query, old deferredQuery. 2) In the background, try the new value too.
slides.say: Type a letter. React first re-renders with the new query but the old deferred query. Then, in the background, it tries rendering with both updated.
If the new results are not ready, you keep seeing the stale list. Dim it when query and deferred query differ, so users know it is updating.
